name: Gl1_GridConnection
description:
Renders Cylinder object

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_GridConnection.wire(=false)

	Only show wireframe (controlled by ``glutSlices`` and ``glutStacks``.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_GridConnection.glutNormalize(=true)

	Fix normals for non-wire rendering

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_GridConnection.glutSlices(=8)

	Number of cylinder slices.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_GridConnection.glutStacks(=4)

	Number of cylinder stacks.

attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.
